lines:
Completed: no adapter drops the provider's refusal text any more, so the "NOT DONE" item on the previous memo is closed.

- AnthropicMessagesProviderError::HttpStatus and GoogleGeminiProviderError::HttpStatus now carry { status: u16, detail: String } and render "Anthropic|Gemini provider returned HTTP status {status}{detail}"; the map sites pass the detail through, so the shared transport excerpt reaches the typed error rather than being discarded.
- Both enums derive Clone, Debug, Error, Eq, PartialEq (no Copy), so the String field is additive; nothing else matched the old tuple shape except the one assertion in tests/provider_protocols.rs, which is updated.
- Two new integration tests drive the real HTTP fixture and assert the whole path end to end: an_anthropic_refusal_keeps_the_providers_own_message (400 with Anthropic's error.message shape) and a_gemini_refusal_keeps_the_providers_own_message (400 with Gemini's error.message shape), each asserting both the typed variant and its rendered Display.

VERIFICATION (this increment)
- cargo test -p aworkit-capability-host (lib AND every integration binary): all "test result: ok", 0 failed - lib 191 passed / 2 ignored, provider_protocols 4 passed (was 2), and every other suite green.
- desktop cargo check --tests: Finished, no errors, only the pre-existing warnings.

STATE OF THE WHOLE CHANGE (tasks #191-#193)
- Prefix cache: between compactions state re-emission is append-only; only a compaction consolidates.
- Text-less turn: reported and continued; a reasoning-only turn never enters the transcript; the renderer drops one that already did, so a stuck Chat replays.
- Repeated refusal: five identical provider failures with no accepted turn in between end the pass with the provider's own words; the failure policy and docs/context-compaction.md now record that exception.
- Refusal diagnostics: OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic and Gemini all carry a bounded 2048-byte single-line excerpt of the provider's own message.

Second half of the user's instruction on 2026-10-07, after the endless-refusal incident (chat.0e61d222be0b04c2ee63ff7c1c0edd14d085e98f).

DECISION RECORDED
- The user confirmed that a model call which keeps failing repetitively must be allowed to end the run: a misconfigured provider, a provider-side outage, or a harness bug cannot be allowed to spin for ever.
- aworkit.workflow_worker.failure_policy is amended accordingly (2026-10-07): invariant 1 now lists four terminating classes, the fourth being "a provider that refuses the same request repeatedly with no accepted turn in between"; the accepted-turn-with-no-answer case is explicitly moved out of the terminating set (the recorded 65,536-token reasoning turn is the case the loop must survive); invariant 4 records that the one attempt-counting ending is a dispatch fact, never a measure of the Agent's progress; the Consequences section now states the exception and the reasoning behind it. Invariant 1's old wording, which listed "a provider that accepts a turn and returns neither an answer nor a tool call" as an unrecoverable refusal, is removed because it contradicted the implemented behaviour since task #191.
- docs/context-compaction.md's "A provider failure never ends a Run" bullet now carries the same exception.

REQUESTED FEATURE
- The provider's own refusal text is now captured instead of a bare status. provider_transport.rs gained PROVIDER_ERROR_EXCERPT_BYTES (2048), bounded_single_line, provider_error_excerpt (prefers error.message, then error.detail, then a bare string, then the raw body) and http_status_detail. BoundedJsonError::HttpStatus and OpenAiCompatibleProviderError::HttpStatus now carry { status, detail } and render "provider returned HTTP status 400: <the provider's words>". The body was previously read and then discarded by context_overflow_response, which is why 335 identical refusals reported only the status. Anthropic and Gemini transport mappings keep their existing status-only shape.

VERIFICATION
- capability-host lib: 191 passed / 0 failed / 2 ignored, including three new provider_error_excerpt_tests (JSON error.message extraction, single-line collapsing and the 2048-byte bound, and the empty-suffix case).
- capability-host integration: provider_protocols 2/2, provider_tool_contracts 4/4, provider_tools_openai 3/3.
- desktop cargo check --tests: Finished with no errors and only the pre-existing warnings.

NOT DONE / OPEN
- Anthropic and Gemini still surface the bare status in their typed provider errors; their shared transport now formats the detail, but the mapping deliberately drops it. Extend the same way if those providers matter.
- The 335-attempt incident was 3 minutes of ~0.6 s refusals; nothing rate-limits retries of a *varying* provider failure, which remains report-and-continue by design.

data.title: Carry the provider's own refusal text in the error, and record the repeated-refusal ending in the failure policy
